ModMetaData.name: Washing Machine · 洗衣机
ModMetaData.author: Nanaloveyuki
ModMetaData.description:
A 1×1 electric washing machine. Removes the dead-person flag from apparel without repairing it. Each cycle takes 30 game seconds. Small creatures can also be washed, although they will not enjoy it.
洗衣机：清除衣物的死人标记，不修复耐久。每次清洗需要30游戏秒。也能把体型符合限制的生物搬进去洗，洗完心情-24，持续1游戏天；体型严格小于0.25的生物有死亡风险。
Harmony is required. IrisMenus, NewRatkinPlus, Dubs Bad Hygiene and Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite are optional, not dependencies.
